text:
sara: kicking off canary for lighthouse-api v5.2.0-hotfix. plan 2% -> 15% over 30m, region=us-central-1. change window 00:00-02:00 UTC. rollout id rl-2026-03-21-05

deploy-bot: started rl-2026-03-21-05: routing 2% to v5.2.0-hotfix (route=/api/lighthouse/*).

jules: smoke harness started. watching 5xx and p99. will post anomalies.

mike: initial checks look fine but one node in us-central-1b shows rising 502s (3->28 in last 2m). attaching a small log snippet.

mike: log:
```nERR upstream-502 host=auth-service shard=us-central-1b
CONNS open 130 -> 420 in 60s
```

sara: hold expansion at 2% while we triage. ops-runbook-bot recs?

ops-runbook-bot: recommend: 1) pause rollout 2) apply per-shard pin to v5.1.9 for us-central-1b 3) capture upstream traces and conn metrics. cmds:
pause: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-05 --reason "hold: upstream 502 us-central-1b"`
pin: `routingctl pin --service lighthouse-api --to-version v5.1.9 --shard us-central-1b`
rollback: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-05 --to-version v5.1.9 --confirm`

deploy-bot: pause requested by sara. pausing rl-2026-03-21-05...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-05 paused at 2% (user: sara). state=PAUSED. note=\"hold: upstream 502 us-central-1b\"

jules: running focused smoke on us-central-1b. QA bot will run gold prompts after traces are uploaded.

qa-bot: gold prompt set queued for us-central-1b.

mike: traces show auth-service returning 502 under medium fanout; connection churn high. creating INFR-2522 and tagging infra-oncall.

infra-oncall (bot): INFR-2522 acknowledged. initial triage: increased connection resets from auth-service under pipelined requests. ETA 25m for mitigation plan.

sara: quick vote: pin us-central-1b to v5.1.9 and keep rollout paused globally? react :+1: to pin+hold, :-1: to continue with investigation.

jules: :+1:

mike: :+1:

release-mgr: :+1: prefer pin and document in changelog.

sara: pin approved. applying routing pin now.

deploy-bot: routingctl: pin applied -> service=lighthouse-api shard=us-central-1b -> version v5.1.9. routing change id rc-11001.

deploy-bot: note: rollout remains PAUSED. no auto-increments until manual resume.

sara: changelog updated: \"paused v5.2.0-hotfix canary due to upstream 502s in us-central-1b; pinned shard to v5.1.9 pending INFR-2522 investigation.\"

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet if needed:
```n# global rollback to stable
deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-05 --to-version v5.1.9 --force --confirm
```

infra-oncall (bot): will post updates here. will attempt connection pool tweak on auth-service in 20m and request a canary recheck after change.

sara: status=PAUSED_PINNED owner=sara. will resume thread when infra posts fix and QA is green. thanks everyone.
